causal_attribution.region_core_quality: D2 has high selected purity but only 0.3973 positive coverage; the core representation is locally precise rather than intrinsically noisy.
causal_attribution.primitive_support: D3 raises fixed IoU from D2 0.3767 and D1 0.5254 to 0.7713 by composing multiple semantic cores, so incomplete object support is the largest measured post-field capacity gap.
causal_attribution.teacher_semantics: Direct teacher primitive response is weak: D4 available-row fixed IoU/AP/oracle-IoU are 0.1556/0.6013/0.4933. Ramen O1 nevertheless gains 0.0635 mIoU under the unchanged readout, proving that teacher-guided field direction remains useful when conservatively fused.
causal_attribution.renderer: D4 end-to-end abstain fixed IoU 0.1491 and D5 rendered fixed IoU 0.1423 differ by only 0.0068. Domain metrics are not directly interchangeable, but the frozen renderer is not consistent with the dominant loss.
causal_attribution.selection_not_capacity: The previous target-blind eight-region novelty union selected all eight slots and regressed Figurines by 0.1185 mIoU; a support mechanism needs reliability evidence and a conservative fallback, not more unconditional regions.

calibration_audit.conclusion: Global absolute probability calibration is not the main frozen-protocol bottleneck because every scale/query channel is independently min-max remapped. Within-query ordering, upper-tail shape, spatial support, and raw peak scale choice remain causal.
